text:
```artifact
states: IDLE, STARTING, RUNNING, SHUTTING_DOWN, SELF_TESTING, CONFIGURING, RECONFIGURING, ERROR

initial: IDLE

events: START, SHUTDOWN, SELF_TEST, CONFIGURE, RECONFIGURE, STATUS_QUERY, ACK, NACK, ERROR_MSG, UNKNOWN_CMD

transitions:
  IDLE --START--> STARTING
  STARTING --ACK--> RUNNING
  RUNNING --SHUTDOWN--> SHUTTING_DOWN
  SHUTTING_DOWN --ACK--> IDLE
  IDLE --SELF_TEST--> SELF_TESTING
  SELF_TESTING --ACK--> IDLE
  IDLE --CONFIGURE--> CONFIGURING
  CONFIGURING --ACK--> IDLE
  RUNNING --RECONFIGURE--> RECONFIGURING
  RECONFIGURING --ACK--> RUNNING
  any --ERROR_MSG--> ERROR
  ERROR --ACK--> IDLE

  // Invalid command handling
  IDLE --SHUTDOWN--> IDLE [reject: NACK]
  RUNNING --START--> RUNNING [reject: NACK]
  IDLE --RECONFIGURE--> IDLE [reject: NACK]
  RUNNING --CONFIGURE--> RUNNING [reject: NACK]
  any --UNKNOWN_CMD--> any [reject: NACK]
  ERROR --STATUS_QUERY--> ERROR [reject: NACK]
```
